draft.body:
Dear Professor Navarra,

UP's account of Sustainability Fiesta 2026 describes your guided transect across campus spaces, built areas and transport, followed by stakeholder discussion (https://upd.edu.ph/upd-hosts-sustainability-fiesta/).

For Proxy Society, I am studying AI representatives acting on limited, revocable instructions. I would trace an identical service request from shaded public approach to foyer to counter, comparing a representative-only handoff with a person returning to take over. Observation would focus on where access, waiting and responsibility become unclear, including people who remain outside.

Could you help shape the transect and stakeholder questions, and advise which PhD in the Designed and Built Environment theme or potential supervisor would fit this architectural enquiry?

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
